# Extraction fixtures

These HTML files are **hand-built approximations** of each platform's job page
markup, written from knowledge of how those sites are structured. They are
**not real captures**. Real pages change often; if a platform starts extracting
badly, save the real page (Ctrl+S, "Webpage, HTML only") into this folder, add
a test case, and adjust the selectors in `extension/extract.js`.
